outlets.name: Saudi Gamer
outlets.press_policy_notes: info@saudigamer.com is the only address on the site (read 2026-11-02): it is the mailto behind the site-wide 'اعلن معنا' (Advertise with us) button and appears in the footer, so it is a general/commercial inbox, not a dedicated editorial desk. Domain MX points to Microsoft 365 (saudigamer-com.mail.protection.outlook.com), so the address can receive mail. No /contact-us or /about-us page exists (404). Pitch in Arabic if possible and state clearly that it is an editorial pitch, not an ad enquiry.
outlets.audience_note: Arabic-language Saudi games, esports and anime network founded 2009, owned by Webedia Arabia Group since Feb 2021. Large reach (YouTube @SaudiGamer approx. 2.5M subs, Instagram approx. 1.9M per third-party trackers). Publishes daily news plus indie-horror listicles.
